name: Mai Tai Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Mai Tai brings a tropical rush of citrus, berries, and floral notes with a sweet tang on the exhale. Bright and flavorful, it is a strain that channels island energy from the first spark. A nod to the cocktail, it is fruit forward and built for sunny day vibes.
